name: NeRF MLP Architecture
definition: A multi-layer perceptron F_Theta that maps 5D coordinates (3D location x and viewing direction d) to volume density sigma and directional emitted color c.
summary: The NeRF MLP is a fully-connected network mapping 3D positions and viewing directions to density and color, distinguished by its separate direction branch for view-dependent effects and positional encoding to overcome spectral bias.
